corrected_code:
@router.get("/features/{flag_key}/audit-history/{target_user_id}")
async def get_flag_evaluation_history(
    flag_key: str,
    target_user_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    if str(current_user.id) != target_user_id and not current_user.is_audit_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to inspect user feature audit history")

    stmt = (
        select(FlagEvaluationAudit)
        .where(
            FlagEvaluationAudit.flag_key == flag_key,
            FlagEvaluationAudit.user_key == target_user_id
        )
        .order_by(FlagEvaluationAudit.evaluated_at.desc())
        .limit(50)
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    records = res.scalars().all()
    return [{"timestamp": r.evaluated_at, "variation": r.evaluated_variation, "reason": r.evaluation_reason} for r in records]
